candidates.title: Ball in the Tree
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the children's ball became wedged in a tall tree before the match before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they jumped beneath it, but their hands could not reach the branches; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a padded loop on a long pole could catch the ball without breaking twigs; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they lifted the ball free carefully and restarted the game on safer ground, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: Night-Blooming Flower
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the celebrated flower remained closed when the evening festival began before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they carried it into a bright tent, but the petals closed even tighter; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized an old gardener's notebook explained that it opened in cool darkness; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they moved the flower outside and watched it open beneath the first stars, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: False Alarm at the Bridge
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the warning bell rang although the bridge was empty before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they closed the crossing, but the bell kept ringing after the wind stopped; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a dangling vine was brushing the bell rope whenever the gate moved; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they secured the vine and tested the warning system before reopening the crossing, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
